reasons.plausibility: The mechanism is physically plausible but hinges on achieving fully coherent interfaces under high pressure, which introduces uncertainty about the viability of doubling strength with major ductility improvements.
reasons.testability: The proposed fracture and EBSD analyses under controlled high-pressure processing conditions provide relatively clear metrics to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Exploring high-pressure alloying to modify interfacial coherency could be of interest for researchers, though the large pressure requirement may limit broader adoption.
